title: The Merneptah Stele

images.caption: The Merneptah Stele in the Egyptian Museum, Cairo.

p: A large granite slab recording Pharaoh Merneptah’s victories. Near the end it lists peoples of Canaan he claims to have defeated: “Ashkelon is carried off, Gezer is seized… Israel is laid waste; his seed is not.”

It is the earliest known mention of Israel outside the Bible. The hieroglyph used marks Israel as a people rather than a city or land, which fits Israel living in the hill country of Canaan in the time of the Judges. The text is Egyptian royal propaganda, and the Bible does not mention this campaign.
